Taptix v2.2 (Build 20) Official Update:
• Fixed Map Work Zone Auto-Accept: Bookings within selected map boundary now accepted instantly without GPS block
• Multi-App Support: Fully optimized for Uber, Ola, Rapido, inDrive, Porter, Namma Yatri
• Hardware Gesture Dispatch: Dual-mode click engine for Flutter & custom canvas buttons
• Instant On-Duty activation when saving map work boundary
